units.source_text: 不管怎么说，我的生中缺乏像鹤川的生那样坚定的象征性。

en.t: In any case, my life lacked the firm symbolic quality that Tsurukawa's life possessed.
That was precisely why I needed him so much.

units.source_text: 而且最令人妒忌的是，他一生中丝毫没有一种像我这样的意识，即肩负着独特性或独自使命的意识。

en.t: And what I envied most was that in his life he had not the slightest consciousness like mine, the consciousness of bearing a uniqueness or a solitary mission.

units.source_text: 而正是这种独特性夺走了生的象征性，夺走了可使他的人生比喻成别的什么的象征性，

en.t: And it was precisely this uniqueness that robbed life of its symbolic quality, robbed it of the symbolism that could have allowed his life to be compared to something else,

units.source_text: 从而也夺走了生的扩展和共同性，以致成为永远摆脱不掉的孤独的根源。

en.t: and thereby also took away life's expansion and commonality, until it became the root of a loneliness from which one could never escape.
This was a strange and incomprehensible thing.

units.source_text: 我连与虚无的共同性都没有了。

en.t: I no longer had even a common bond with nothingness.
